instruction: Change the slide orientation of this presentation to portrait.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to change all text fonts to Liberation Sans Narrow via master slide editing. Spent 50 turns editing individual template elements in master slide view and tried Find & Replace, but failed to change fonts across all text boxes.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress UI, enter master slide view, select text, change font properties in Character panel, use keyboard shortcuts like Ctrl+H
metadata.failure_analysis: Model edited master slide template elements one-by-one instead of using a bulk method. Got confused between font variants. Find & Replace cannot change fonts. Task limit reached at 50 turns.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single property change (slide orientation) that requires navigating Slide menu. Model demonstrated ability to interact with slide properties panel.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide orientation from landscape to portrait via Slide > Slide Size. Evaluator reads the pptx file and checks if height > width.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads pptx slide dimensions via python-pptx and determines portrait orientation by checking height > width
Metric correctly handles expected parameter as direct rules dict (expected.get('orientation')) per framework convention for type='rule'
Postconfig properly saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring fresh state
Complete coverage: single instruction requirement (portrait orientation) is fully verified by the evaluator
Data flow is correct: getter extracts width/height → computes is_portrait → metric compares against expected orientation
